lines: His son Cukhulaka thus among people known moon white intellect Narasiṃhagupta; whom all śāstra taste immersed pure mind Māheśvarī supremely adorns indeed devotion.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tasyātmajaścukhalaketi jane prasiddhaścandrāvadātadhiṣaṇo narasiṃhaguptaḥ yaṃ sarvaśāstrarasamajjanaśubhracittaṃ māheśvarī paramalaṃkurute sma bhaktiḥ
